IT Support Services

Office of the CITO

Room: 205, Floor: 1, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Office of the Chief Information & Technology Officer (CITO) at BUBT manages the university’s IT infrastructure, digital services, and technology initiatives. It oversees system development, network management, cybersecurity, and digital innovation to support academic, administrative, and research activities efficiently and securely.

Services of Our Office

Network & Infrastructure

Campus-wide LAN, WAN, and Wi-Fi services Internet connectivity and bandwidth management Server, data center, and cloud infrastructure support Network security and access control

Hardware & Technical Support

Installation and maintenance of IT equipment Desktop, laptop, printer, and lab support Smart classroom and multimedia system management

Software & Application Services

University management systems and ERP support Website, portal, and web application management Software deployment, licensing, and updates Custom application development and integration

Information Security & IT Governance

IT policies, standards, and compliance Data protection and system security Backup, disaster recovery, and risk management

Academic & Administrative IT Support

Learning Management System (LMS) support Online examination and academic systems Email and collaboration platforms Process automation and digital services

User Support & Helpdesk

IT helpdesk and technical assistance Support for faculty, staff, and students User training and guidance
